# Production-base migration fixture

`110485c.db` is the independent review's `base-110485c.db`, generated by
`/work/lanes/tunn-refresh-review/baseline/.reviewseed/main.go` compiled from
production base `110485c`. It contains 20 original tables and 20 existing rows,
including account aliases, a merge, authorized and pending device codes, used
magic links, and operations, metering and MCP records. Tests copy it into a
temporary directory and compare all original schemas and rows after initializing
the durable schema twice. The fixture is never opened for writes in place.

`110485c-tokens.json` was signed in an archived `110485c` checkout using its
JWT dependency and the review's fixture signing key. Its legacy `access` and
`session` claims have a fixed issuance timestamp (1791710000) and distant expiry
(4000000000), so the regression remains usable beyond the review date. This
lifetime is test data, not the production credential lifetime.

All credentials and identities in these files are local test fixtures.
